title: Grateful Dead Live at Euphoria Ballroom on 1970-07-14
lineage: SBD > MR > Cass > DAT > CDR > EAC > SHN

ai_review.summary: Soundboard source that captures a great acoustic set with banter and rare How Long Blues, but the electric set is hampered by mix and buzzing problems despite standout China>Rider and The Other One.
ai_review.review: The recording delivers a clear, enjoyable acoustic portion highlighted by strong banter, a rare "How Long Blues" performance, and a guest jam with David Crosby. The electric half suffers from noticeable mix and buzz issues, though moments like the smoking China > Rider sequence and a thick‑nice 1970 drum sound on "The Other One" shine through.

ai_rating.rationale: Reviewers rate the show positively for the acoustic set and note several electric highlights, but both point out mix/buzz problems that lower overall enjoyment; combined with a decent but not flawless soundboard source this yields a mid‑high rating.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Acoustic set sounds clear and well‑balanced, while the electric portion has mix issues and buzzing that detract from clarity.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Acoustic set flows smoothly with engaging banter and rare material; electric set is uneven—mix problems interrupt the flow, but strong jams like China>Rider and a powerful The Other One provide high points.

band_member_comments.Bob: Bob takes his time with the lyrics on "El Paso", giving a unique vocal delivery.
band_member_comments.Drums: 1970‑style thick, nice drums highlighted on "The Other One".
